user.title: Connect to HPE OpsRamp
user.description: In OpsRamp: Setup → Account → Integrations, add a Custom Integration, set its inbound authentication to OAUTH2 with a role that can read alerts, resources and tickets, and generate a key. Enter your tenant's API host, the tenant id, the key and the secret. The secret is stored only in this config entry. Nothing in OpsRamp is changed unless you allow alert actions in the options later.
